x.description: scalar or array. Specifies the bases.
constraints: x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes

y.description: scalar or array. Specifies the exponents. ``x`` and ``y`` should either have same shape or be broadcast compatible.
constraints: x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes

output.description: An array containing the base ``x`` exponentials of ``y``, promoting to the inexact dtype.

constraints: x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes
